guardrails: The 23.033% baseline burnup remains a repository surrogate anchor, not a measured burn fraction.
OpenMC does not transport protons; blanket attenuation is not proton stopping suppression.
The missing decisive input is physical boron density/areal density/path length and the corresponding hot-plasma stopping/straggling per encounter.
FF has not yet been demonstrated to sustain the required low-energy non-Maxwellian distribution at reactor scale.
